commands.help:
Usage: prodpilot [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...                                                      
                                                                                                   
 ProdPilot MCP server.                                                                             
                                                                                                   
┌─ Options ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --help          Show this message and exit.                                                     │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ Commands ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ serve     Serve the ProdPilot MCP server over stdio.                                            │
│ setup     Store the GitHub token and Render API key for this developer.                         │
│ doctor    Report whether ProdPilot's prerequisites are in place.                                │
│ connect   Connect an IDE's agent to ProdPilot, naming this machine's prodpilot command.         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

connect.help:
Usage: prodpilot connect [OPTIONS] CLIENT                                                         
                                                                                                   
 Connect an IDE's agent to ProdPilot, naming this machine's prodpilot command.                     
                                                                                                   
 VS Code and Cursor are connected once for every project; Devin, which blanks the                  
 ${workspaceFolder} other configurations use, once per project.                                    
                                                                                                   
┌─ Arguments ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ *    client      TEXT  [required]                                                               │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ Options ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --project        TEXT  Devin only: the project folder you open in Devin. Defaults to the        │
│                        current directory.                                                       │
│                        [default: .]                                                             │
│ --help                 Show this message and exit.                                              │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

doctor.help:
Usage: prodpilot doctor [OPTIONS]                                                                 
                                                                                                   
 Report whether ProdPilot's prerequisites are in place.                                            
                                                                                                   
 Exits non-zero when something required is missing, so the failure is visible to a script rather   
 than buried in output.                                                                            
                                                                                                   
┌─ Options ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --project        TEXT  Also check the project state conventions for this directory.             │
│ --help                 Show this message and exit.                                              │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

setup.help:
Usage: prodpilot setup [OPTIONS]                                                                  
                                                                                                   
 Store the GitHub token and Render API key for this developer.                                     
                                                                                                   
 Values are written to ~/.prodpilot/config.toml, never inside a project. Nothing entered here is   
 printed back to the terminal.                                                                     
                                                                                                   
┌─ Options ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --help          Show this message and exit.                                                     │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
